title: keel routing
description: The Board-approved .keel/routing.yaml: seat to runtime, profile alias and tier bindings with Board-declared families. It holds NAMES only: environment variable names, aliases, protocol, declared family and auth mode. No field can hold an endpoint, a key or a model name; the user sets those values in their own environment. Dispatch refuses without a valid document approval.

profile.description: A provider profile. With auth env, the variable names default to KEEL_PROFILE_<ALIAS>_*.

family.description: Declared family: a Board-approved declaration, shown as declared and never as verified.

runtime_profile.description: Required for auth runtime-profile, null otherwise.

revision.description: Bumped by the user whenever they change the model behind this alias; conformance results are keyed by alias and revision.

envNames.description: Environment variable NAMES. keel dereferences the values only in process memory, at spawn and at direct-lane call time, never opens a file or record that holds one, and never persists, prints, logs or hashes them.

base_url.description: Name of the variable holding the endpoint (default KEEL_PROFILE_<ALIAS>_BASE_URL).

api_key.description: Name of the variable holding the key (default KEEL_PROFILE_<ALIAS>_API_KEY).

model.description: Names of the variables holding the model per tier (default KEEL_PROFILE_<ALIAS>_MODEL_<TIER>).

runtimeProfile.description: A runtime-profile route. The runtime home holds values in a file, so the route serves only tool-less seats or seats whose tool file exposure is blocked.

home_env.description: Name of the variable that points at the runtime home, for example CODEX_HOME or KIMI_CODE_HOME.

profile.description: Name of a profile or alias defined in the user-owned runtime configuration, passed by name only.

independent_of.description: Seats whose declared family must differ from this seat's. For the reviewer it is checked per lens against the seat that wrote the reviewed artifact (org/seats/reviewer.yaml), so it lists product, architect, planner and engineer.

test_route.description: Engineer only: the route of test-first tasks (work order kind test). Its profile's declared family must differ from the engineer route's, so the frozen tests and the build come from different declared families (plan.test-independence). Omitted or null: test tasks use the engineer route, and plan.test-independence then needs fixed tests or a routing deviation.

routeBinding.description: A runtime, profile alias and tier binding.

no_silent_fallback.description: Always true: an unavailable or incompatible route is blocked(runtime_unavailable), never switched.

record_model_names.description: Whether run events may keep the runtime-reported model id (default false).

allow_degraded.description: Whether a single-family review may proceed with a per-change keel approve --rule degraded.

note.description: Single-line free text, at most 280 characters. It cannot hold a URL or a key-shaped token: '://' and any run of 24 or more non-space characters are rejected.

route.description: A resolved route, frozen into run records, snapshots and events. Names only.
